scope: Measurement-only repair of the inconclusive v1 Linux attempt. It does not modify the frozen profile, policy, candidate, receipt, exact graph, certificate, source material, or Windows evidence bundle.

repair.defect: The v1 gate used /sys/class/net, whose inherited sysfs mount exposed host interface names and stopped the driver before qualification even though the process had entered a new network namespace.
unchanged_gates: no IPv4 or IPv6 default route
two active numeric-address IPv4 egress probes fail for explicit network-unreachable reasons before and after trusted execution
all trusted descendants execute inside the unshared network and PID namespaces
all scientific receipt fields except environment match the frozen Windows reference

online_provisioning: instantiate and precompile the frozen Julia environment
capture a hash-bound v2 provisioning manifest containing dependency artifacts, executable identities, package inventory, runner identity, Git commit, and UTC completion time
egress_denied_execution: enter a fresh Linux network namespace
require socket.if_nameindex() and /proc/net/dev independently to report only loopback
record /sys/class/net only as non-gating diagnostic context
require no IPv4 or IPv6 default route
require two active numeric-address IPv4 TCP egress probes to fail for explicit network-unreachable reasons before and after trusted execution
verify unchanged pre-isolation provisioning-manifest hashes and timestamp
execute Python, Julia/Nemo, Lean, and all 373 mandatory challenges
freeze and structurally replay the Linux evidence bundle
compare all non-environment receipt fields with the frozen Windows reference

must_match_exactly: all output verification classes and evidence bindings
allowed_to_differ: verification receipt hash induced solely by environment metadata

result_retention: Every attempted run preserves available logs, provisioning evidence, and exit disposition. A failed or inconclusive attempt cannot be promoted and is never replaced in place by a retry.
evidence_status: No v2 Linux result is earned until this workflow completes successfully, satisfies every linked acceptance criterion, and its result artifact is preserved and reviewed.
